item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Your calendar has the diabetes meds with the cholesterol injection set for morning. Treat that slot as fixed, not optional. Consistency matters more than perfection, and a missed dose rarely announces itself until later. Pair it with something you already do daily, so it becomes automatic. Check that your supply isn't running low before it becomes a problem. Your action: right now, confirm you have enough medication on hand for the next two weeks.
